The '''Republic superweapon initiative''' was a weapons research and development program started by the brilliant [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. After spending four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] studying the technology of the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Godera worked with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to develop powerful [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], though he would resign before most of his ideas were put into action. The [[Planet Prison]], [[Death Mark laser]], [[Power Guard Enhancement System]], [[Shadow Arsenal]], and the [[Shock Drum]] were all created by the initiative using Godera's notes and research.
